the equity returns of bankrupt firms are affected by differences in bankruptcy code and that the differences in equity returns are correlated to the differences in bankruptcy codes among the six countries we examine.
differences in bankruptcy laws among countries are correlated with differences and similarities in equity returns for bankrupt firms in these same countries.
